    """
    Return True if any two numbers in *nums* differ by less than *threshold*.
    
    The function first sorts the list (to guarantee that the closest

3. `any(...)` stops as soon as it finds a pair whose absolute difference is `< threshold`, giving an efficient `O(n log n)` overall complexity (dominated by the sort).
